[[Blade of the Hierophant]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[sword]] obtained from the [[Hierophant's Chest]], which spawns after defeating [[Duncan the Black]] in [[Slavers' Exile]].

==Stats==
:[[Fire damage]]: 15-22 (Requires 9 [[Swordsmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
Blade of the Hierophant uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Fiery Embersteel Blade]].
